permissions.fir.register: Register an FIR at the user's own police station
permissions.fir.read_station: Open the FIRs of the user's own police station (not their records)
permissions.case.lead: May be made Investigating Officer of an FIR of the user's station
permissions.evidence.custody: Hold and hand over evidence of the user's station (malkhana)
permissions.admin.manage: Manage accounts and stations (inside the admin's own state)
permissions.policy.set: Tighten the policies of the user's own unit (station or district, by the role's case_scope)
permissions.import.run: Load existing records from a file for a police station in the user's reach (station, district or state, by the role)
permissions.chargesheet.approve: Approve or return a final report (chargesheet, BNSS 193) drafted by an officer of a station in the user's reach (never one's own)
permissions.audit.read_protected: See who read protected victim details (BNS 72) at a police station in the user's reach (station, district or state, by the role)
permissions.pack.propose: Write down a change to the pack of the user's own state (a playbook, form or deadline rule) for approval; the platform admin, who has no state, for any state
permissions.pack.approve: Approve or send back a pack change proposed for the user's own state (never one's own; the state comes from the user's police station)
permissions.acting.grant: Give an officer of a station in the user's reach (district or state, by the role) a temporary role that the role marks as acting.allowed, with a reason and an end date of at most 90 days; end it early (never one's own)
permissions.acting.allowed: A role an officer of the station may hold for a limited time while its holder is away (acting charge, BNSS 2(1)(r)); only a holder of acting.grant gives it
